description: DeepWorkPlan configuration file, v1 (spec/CONFIG.md): <repo>/.dwp/config.json and ~/.dwp/config.json share this shape. Two keys today - benchmark (spec/BENCHMARK.md section 1) and addons (the addon registry, spec/CONFIG.md section 3). Read by one stdlib parser, shared/config.py. Fail-closed at runtime: a malformed or wrong-typed value disables what it affects with one warning; it never aborts a flow. Unknown top-level keys and unknown addon keys are tolerated for forward compatibility (the reader ignores an unknown addon key with one warning). The registry is informative: no addon entry gates conformance or any plan.

schema.description: Optional self-identification; the reader does not require it.

benchmark.description: Opt-in field metrics (spec/BENCHMARK.md). Resolved wholesale: a repository file that carries this object overrides the user file.

host.description: Machine-readable host capability record (F-17, spec/CONFIG.md section 3a): which abilities the host that runs plans here provides. Per capability the user file wins over the repository file (the record describes a machine); an explicit resources.py --caps declaration wins over both. Unstated capabilities stay at the all-False floor; the reader ignores an unknown or non-boolean capability with one warning.

addons.description: The addon registry. Keys are in-pack addon directory names (contract amendment A1); resolved per key, repository entry over user entry. Absent means not enabled.

enabled.description: Required to enable; only true enables.

version.description: Informative product tag the repository expects (verify warns on a mismatch, never fails).

note.description: Optional one-line note on the decision, e.g. 'accepted; machine-level install deferred'. An enabled addon that is not detected and carries a note is reported as deferred, without a warning.
